messages:
Jordan: Heads up — multiple support tickets reporting p95/p99 lines gone from the latency dashboard after the telemetry collector swap (~03:15 UTC). Customers only see p50 and max now.
Maya: I noticed it in our staging org too, panels for tail percentiles are empty. @Alex any clues?
Alex: Can you paste the dashboard URL + panel id and what exactly changed in the collector flip?
Jordan: https://console.redwood.example/d/abc123/latency?orgId=1&panelId=7 — panel 7. We rolled otel-collector-v2 -> otel-collector-v3 and enabled aggregated_histograms in the config.
Priya: That explains it — the new collector emits histogram buckets rather than precomputed summary/quantile series. Existing panels were querying `request_latency_p95` style metrics which no longer exist. Quick test: switch the panel query to use Prometheus histogram functions, e.g.
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))
```
and repeat with 0.99 for p99.
Alex: Confirmed — old exporter emitted `request_latency_p95`/`_p99` summary metrics. The collector conversion turned them into `_bucket` series and the precomputed labels were removed.
Jordan: I tried the histogram_quantile replacement on the panel and p95/p99 came back instantly. Workaround works.
Maya: Short-term: update dashboards to use histogram_quantile so end users aren't seeing blanks. Long-term: decide if we should emit both summary and bucket metrics or keep dashboards query-agnostic.
Priya: Created GH issue redwood/telemetry#412 with config diff, reproduction steps, and the collector rollout id. Added remediation runbook: either set `aggregated_histograms: false` on the collector or update affected panels to use `histogram_quantile`. Also included a script to grep dashboards for references to `request_latency_p95` to find impacted panels.
Alex: I'll coordinate with metrics team to push dashboard PRs. Jordan — please add affected customer IDs and examples to the issue so support can notify them.
Jordan: Added customer list and example screenshots to the ticket, will send the customer update template once PR merges. :white_check_mark:
Alex: Marking a postmortem if >3 customers affected. Current count?
Jordan: 5 distinct tickets opened so far, escalating to priority-high.
Observability-bot: deploy event recorded: collector v3 rolled out to prod at 2026-03-17T03:15:12Z — roll id abcd-1234.
Priya: Note for the runbook: when changing exporters, run `grep -R "request_latency_p95" dashboards/` to find panels that need updating before rollouts.
Alex: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/observability/pull/789 — will merge after 2 approvals and smoke tests.
Maya: Thanks team, glad we had a quick workaround. :heart:
